description: Agent Aviation Records: submit incident report records with the flight and maintenance records and follow-up entries they answer to: the moment the records are read at; each flight or maintenance entry with its id, reference, its kind (flight or maintenance), tail number, the moment recorded and the occurrence it notes; each incident report with its id, reference, the entry it reports, tail number, the moment the occurrence happened, the moment follow-up is due and its status (open or closed); each follow-up entry with its id, reference, the report it follows and the moment recorded. The signed report gives the reports and the records behind them, each occurrence a flight or maintenance entry notes against a report on file, each report against a follow-up entry behind it, each report’s date against the entry it reports, and each open report against the follow-up date it states, and counts them, and names divergent incident records: an incident appearing in the flight or maintenance records with no report on file, a report recorded with no follow-up entry behind it, a report date the underlying records do not match, and a report still open past the follow-up date the record states; then a report naming an entry the flight and maintenance records do not hold and a follow-up entry naming a report the records do not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No entries and no reports, or reports with follow-up dates and no reading moment, leaves those points unverified. Reports, entries and tail numbers match by letters and digits, an occurrence is reported by a report naming its entry or, naming none, on its aircraft on its day, dates read by the day, and a report with no status reads as open. This reads the air operator’s own incident reports: wever_incident-evidence-check reads claims about a service incident against its timeline, while the incident report check reads whether every occurrence in the flight and maintenance records was reported, followed up and closed on time. Verdict aviation_incident_report_divergent, aviation_incident_report_partial, aviation_incident_report_unverified or aviation_incident_report_consistent. POST /api/aviation-incident-report-check. Reads the aviation records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it flies no aircraft, inspects no aircraft in person, contacts no regulator, examiner or maintenance provider and issues no certification, which stay with the operator, its pilots, its mechanics and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Aviation Records reads an air operator’s own records: flight log records, aircraft maintenance records, airworthiness and directive records, inspection records, pilot certificate records, training and currency records, flight duty and rest records and incident report records, each against the fleet, maintenance, pilot and duty records, the mechanic, certificate and part records, the flight log and the maintenance record, the aircraft, operations and dates flown, the schedule and the corrective entries, the required events and the currency records, the operator’s own limits, or the follow-up entries on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the aircraft and the crew: what the flight log shows, what the maintenance record supports, what the certificates cover, and whether the duty and incident records hold up; it reads records about aircraft and crews, not live flight tracking and not travel booking: the Agent Travel family reads the bookings behind a trip, the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production records and the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety file, while this family reads an air operator’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-aviation-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-aviation-records/.

as_of.description: The reading moment, such as 2026-03-02 or 2026-03-02T14:30Z.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

ref.description: The flight or maintenance entry reference.

follow_up_due_at.description: When follow-up is due, such as 2026-03-02 or 2026-03-02T14:30Z.

occurred_at.description: When the occurrence happened, such as 2026-03-02 or 2026-03-02T14:30Z.

record.description: The flight or maintenance entry reference.
